# Healthcare Survey Guide

Canonical site: https://myeloblast18.github.io/healthcare-survey-guide/
Last updated: 2026-08-30

Independent directory covering paid healthcare market-research panels and HCP professional communities.

Core pages: /best-paid-medical-surveys.html, /signup-bonuses.html, /screenout-compensation.html, /residents-fellows-medical-surveys.html, /companies.html.

Company reviews: /enos-health-review.html, /zoomrx-review.html, /sermo-review.html, /m3-global-research-review.html, /all-global-circle-review.html, /mdforlives-review.html, /primum-review.html, /healthcasts-review.html.

Referral links are disclosed and marked sponsored/nofollow. Company-policy claims are separated from contributor observations.

## Panel comparisons
- [ZoomRx vs Sermo](https://myeloblast18.github.io/healthcare-survey-guide/zoomrx-vs-sermo.html): Eligibility, payment and signup comparison.
- [Enos vs ZoomRx](https://myeloblast18.github.io/healthcare-survey-guide/enos-vs-zoomrx.html): Screen-out policies and payment methods.
- [Start here](https://myeloblast18.github.io/healthcare-survey-guide/start-here.html): Choose an appropriate panel.
